decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [10, 11, 100, 101, 102, 103, 105, 106, 151, 152, 153, 161, 170, 171, 172, 205, 260, 261, 400, Design and Access Statement & Heritage Impact Assessment, Preliminary Diagnostic, Non-destructive, Environmental Timber Decay Survey and Ecological Appraisal. Received: 05/08/2025 
150 and 250. Received: 17/09/2025].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 4 - Prior to commencement of groundworks (excluding site investigations and demolition), the applicant shall have submitted to the local planning authority for approval in writing a final detailed drainage design, including drawings and supporting calculations [and an updated Drainage Assessment Form to be reviewed and approved by the Lead Local Flood Authority], aligned with the [add in date and name of main drainage document(s)] and associated material hereby approved. A detailed management plan confirming routine maintenance tasks for all drainage components shall also be submitted and approved which demonstrates how the drainage system is to be maintained for the lifetime of the development. The development shall be carried out in strict compliance with the approved details.
Reason: In order to prevent the risk of flooding to and from the site.
description: Installation of new timber boards, metal floor plates, high metal railings, laminated glass, balustrades, electrical system conduits, laminated glass infill panels and roof hatch. Replacing all the existing windows, rainwater downpipes and underground drainage. Alterations to the existing engine cylinders, floor boards, redundant timber lifting beam, wrought iron roof trusses bearing ends, roof alterations with roof sheets, fall prevention system wire and posts, front entrance railings and steps, internal and external alterations following asbestos removal. Listed building consent P/2025/2385
subdivision_of_building: Great Engine House only and associated below ground drainage.
